prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / character identity correction.
Asset type: transparent dialogue portrait for the fantasy game Scroll Hunter.
EDIT IMAGE 1, the existing mage illustration. Preserve the existing illustrated portrait's useful three-quarter upper-body composition, staff on the viewer's LEFT, one empty spellcasting hand on the RIGHT, and stern mood. Redraw the mage's identity and outfit to MATCH THE GAME MODEL shown in IMAGES 2 and 3. IMAGE 4 is the exact existing game STAFF reference.

Model identity and costume:
A mature male corrupted mage, strong stern brow, broad straight nose, deep-set dark eyes visible under the hood, medium weathered skin, short neatly trimmed grey beard and moustache hugging the jaw. Match the face in image 3 in a hand-drawn way. NO long pointed white goatee, skeletal old-man face, huge nose or invented scars.
A simple fitted charcoal-black hood with narrow muted antique-gold piping along the opening and central seam. NO giant crest or badge on the hood. Charcoal robe, broad layered short shoulder cape/yoke with thin worn gold edging and restrained gold rune embroidery, small clasp at the center of the upper chest. Long relatively straight sleeves with gold-trimmed cuffs. Central vertical robe panels with sparse gold embroidery. Practical brown leather belt, dull simple buckle and small brown pouch at the hip, as in image 2.
Remove the existing portrait's purple lining, ragged purple shoulder drapery, excessive pendants and dangling jewelry. The clothing must clearly be the same outfit as the game model, simplified for the existing cartoon illustration style.

Staff: closely reproduce IMAGE 4, NOT the elaborate staff in image 1. A slender mostly straight dark-brown wooden shaft with modest uneven wood contour. The head is a vertical elongated purple oval gemstone enclosed by a few narrow muted gold/brass cage ribs, tapering together above and below the gem. Simple compact elongated head, proportionate to the narrow shaft. A subtle purple internal glow is fine. No giant twisting roots, ribbons, hanging charms, flames or plume of smoke. His gripping hand must wrap naturally around the shaft.

Art style: smooth 2D fantasy cartoon illustration, clean natural curved outlines, soft blended cel shadows and broad painted color shapes. Keep the illustration family of image 1, but avoid angular polygonal shading. DO NOT copy the 3D render finish or noisy textures from the model. No photoreal skin pores, PBR fabric sheen, gritty microtexture, triangles or visible low-poly facets.
Frame one upper-body character from hood to just below belt, entire hood, staff head, shoulders and hands inside the frame, small safe transparent margin. Staff shaft can continue through the lower crop. True transparent background, clean alpha edges, no scenery, black backdrop, checkerboard, ground, text, labels or watermark. Natural five-finger hands.
